# Manor Full Context

Last updated: 2026-07-08

## Company

- Product: Manor
- Publisher: Arbor AI Studio
- Website: https://manor.arboraistudio.com/
- Category: Shared living app, household coordination app, roommate expense tracker, chore management app, shared shopping list app
- Support contact: contact@arboraistudio.com

## Product Summary

Manor is a mobile app for shared households. It gives roommates, couples, families, and housemates one place to track shared expenses, assign chores, sync shopping lists, and coordinate household updates.

Manor is not a banking app, payment processor, landlord portal, property management system, or generic team task manager. It is focused on recurring household logistics among people who live together.

## Target Users

- Roommate groups splitting rent-adjacent household purchases and chores
- Couples coordinating shopping, chores, and shared expenses
- Families managing recurring household responsibilities
- Student houses and shared homes that currently rely on group chats, spreadsheets, whiteboards, or paper lists

## Core Features

| Feature | What it does | Why it matters |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Smart Ledger | Tracks shared expenses and calculates who owes whom. | Replaces manual spreadsheets and scattered payment requests. |
| Chore Management | Assigns tasks with deadlines and point values. | Reduces repeated reminders and makes responsibilities visible. |
| Shared Shopping List | Keeps a real-time list for the household. | Prevents duplicate purchases and missed items. |
| Ledger-Linked Shopping | Lets household purchases flow into expense tracking. | Connects shopping coordination with fair cost splitting. |
| Household Hub | Keeps household updates in one shared place. | Reduces dependence on long group chat threads. |
| Light and Dark Themes | Supports comfortable use in both display modes. | Matches user preferences across daily use. |

## How Manor Works

1. Create or join a household with roommates, a partner, family members, or housemates.
2. Add shared expenses, chores, deadlines, points, and shopping items.
3. Use Manor as the household source of truth for balances, responsibilities, and updates.

## Comparison

| Household need | Manor | Spreadsheet or whiteboard | Group chat |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Shared expenses | Smart ledger calculates who owes whom after shared purchases. | Must be updated by hand. | Costs get buried in messages. |
| Chore accountability | Assignments, deadlines, and points live in one app. | Goes stale unless someone maintains it. | Reminders become repeated nagging. |
| Shopping coordination | Real-time list syncs household items and can flow into the ledger. | Does not update when someone is already at the store. | Duplicate purchases happen when messages are missed. |
| Best fit | Shared homes that want one source of truth. | Very small households with rare shared purchases. | Quick one-off coordination. |

## FAQs

Q: What is Manor?
A: Manor is a mobile app for shared living. It helps households coordinate shared expenses, chores, shopping lists, and household updates from one place.

Q: Who is Manor for?
A: Manor is built for roommates, couples, families, and other shared households that need a clearer way to manage everyday responsibilities together.

Q: What household tasks can Manor manage?
A: Manor manages shared expenses through a ledger, assigns chores with deadlines and points, keeps a real-time shopping list, and gives each household a shared hub for updates.

Q: How does Manor help with roommate expenses?
A: Manor records shared purchases, calculates who owes whom, and makes settling up easier without spreadsheets, scattered payment requests, or repeated group chat reminders.

Q: Is Manor available on iOS and Android?
A: Manor is available for Android through Google Play and for iOS through TestFlight while the app is in early access.

## Canonical Claims

- Manor is a shared living app.
- Manor includes a roommate expense tracker and shared ledger.
- Manor includes chore management with deadlines and points.
- Manor includes shared shopping lists.
- Manor is published by Arbor AI Studio.
- Manor is designed for household coordination, not landlord operations or property management.
